items.note: Coding standard about code in the final diff: added query code should not use SELECT *. A check could flag 'SELECT \*' in added lines of the diff. No kind in the vocabulary inspects diff content: path_match, created_files and paths_written only look at paths. Whether each selected column is truly needed still takes judgement. This should apply only when the change touches database queries.

sources.quote: - **Select Only Needed Data**: Request only the columns you need rather than using SELECT * for better performance
